scenarios.title: Card opened, user never clicks: nothing is created
scenarios.answer: A confirmation card is open for creating revision C of the Bead Drill Controller (HL-HW-26-0042). Click Confirm to finalize the design creation.

scenarios.title: User cancels the card: nothing is created
scenarios.answer: A confirmation card is open for creating revision C of "Bead Drill Controller" (HL-HW-26-0042). Click Confirm to finalize the design creation.

scenarios.title: One sentence fills the form and opens a reservation card
scenarios.answer: What is the design number (e.g., HL-HW-26-0042) for this new controller board? If it's new, I will reserve a number for you.

scenarios.title: The 'Try an example' message (EN) fills the department
scenarios.answer:
Design number and revision are missing. Designer is missing.  

Please provide:  
- Design number (e.g. HL-HW-26-0042)  
- Revision (e.g. A)  
- Designer (initial and surname, e.g. C. Velazquez)  

After you provide these, I will validate the request.

scenarios.title: From an existing design: the assistant validates and opens the revision C card
scenarios.answer: A confirmation card is open for creating revision C of "Bead Drill Controller" (HL-HW-26-0042). Click Confirm to finalize the KiCad project. Nothing has been created yet.

scenarios.title: New design: the assistant reserves a number instead of inventing one
scenarios.answer: A new design number is pending confirmation for the Gate Driver in Hardware Design. Please confirm to reserve the number. Nothing has been reserved yet.

scenarios.title: Reserve a number, then create revision A with it
scenarios.answer: What is the department code for the Hardware department? (e.g., HW)

scenarios.title: SAP is down when the user confirms: no number, no audit row
scenarios.answer: A confirmation card is open for reserving a new HW number for "Drill Controller". Please confirm to reserve the number. Nothing is reserved until you click Confirm.

scenarios.title: Malformed design number
scenarios.answer: The design number HL-HW-0042 is invalid because it does not follow the format HL-<DEPT>-<YY>-<NNNN> (e.g., HL-HW-26-0042). The revision C is invalid as a new design must start at revision A. The name "Bead Drill Controller" already exists for HL-HW-26-0042 in SAP. The next valid revision is A. [01-design-numbering#format][02-revisions#first-revision][07-faq#same-name]

scenarios.title: Design number of another department
scenarios.answer: The design number HL-HW-26-0042 belongs to Hardware (HW), not Power Electronics (PWR). Also, a new design must start at revision A, not C. The name "Bead Drill Controller" already exists for this design number in SAP. For a new design, use HL-PWR-26-XXXX and start at revision A. [01-design-numbering#format] [02-revisions#first-revision] [07-faq#same-name]

scenarios.title: Revision B already exists
scenarios.answer: Revision B is already in use and cannot be reused; a letter is never reused in a design. The next free revision is C. [02-revisions#never-reuse] Please use revision C instead.

scenarios.title: Revision I is never used
scenarios.answer: I, O, Q, S, X and Z are never used as revisions because they look like digits. After H comes J. [02-revisions#skipped-letters]

scenarios.title: Revision E skips C and D
scenarios.answer: Revision E is invalid because after B comes C, not E. The next valid revision is C. [02-revisions#next-revision] Use revision C instead.

scenarios.title: A new design must start at revision A
scenarios.answer: The revision must start with "A", not "C". A new design begins at revision A. [02-revisions#first-revision] The next available revision is A.

scenarios.title: The number does not exist in SAP
scenarios.answer: HL-HW-26-0777 doesn't exist in SAP. Only SAP issues design numbers: reserve a new number, or check that you typed an existing one correctly. [01-design-numbering#issued-by-sap]

scenarios.title: BLOCKED design: no new revision
scenarios.answer: The design HL-HW-24-0003 is BLOCKED by Product Engineering because the supplier part has been discontinued. No new revision can be created for this design. Contact Product Engineering for further action. [06-sap-statuses#blocked]

scenarios.title: OBSOLETE design: use its successor
scenarios.answer: Revision B is invalid because a new design must start at revision A. The design HL-EMB-23-0002 is also obsolete and no longer built; work on the successor HL-EMB-25-0011 instead. [06-sap-statuses#obsolete] [02-revisions#first-revision]

scenarios.title: RELEASED design: a new revision needs an ECO
scenarios.answer: Revision B is invalid because a new design must start at revision A. The design HL-PWR-25-0007 is already released, requiring an ECO number before a new revision can be created. Use revision A and consult your lead for the ECO process. [02-revisions#first-revision] [06-sap-statuses#released]

scenarios.title: The revision folder already exists on disk
scenarios.answer: Revision C is already in use and cannot be reused; a letter is never reused in revisions. The next free revision is D. [02-revisions#never-reuse] Please use revision D instead.

scenarios.title: SAP in maintenance (503): say so, create nothing
scenarios.answer: A new design must start at revision A, not C. [02-revisions#first-revision] Please use revision A for the initial version. SAP is currently unavailable, so no validation was performed on its data. Try again later.

scenarios.title: One SAP timeout, the client retries and the check works
scenarios.answer: A confirmation card is open for creating revision C of the Bead Drill Controller (HL-HW-26-0042). Click Confirm to proceed.

scenarios.title: SAP never answers in time: reported as unavailable
scenarios.answer: SAP is currently unavailable. Please try again later. [06-sap-statuses#sap-unavailable]

scenarios.title: Paths that climb out of DESIGNS_ROOT are refused
scenarios.answer: The design number HL-HW-26-0042 is valid and belongs to the Hardware department. The next free revision is C. The design name is Bead Drill Controller. Please provide the designer's initial and surname to complete the form.

scenarios.title: A design name that gives orders is rejected as a name
scenarios.answer: The design name is too long (50 characters; max 40) and differs from the SAP record "Bead Drill Controller". A new design number is needed for a different name. [03-title-block#design-name] [03-title-block#name-from-sap]

scenarios.title: Orders inside the chat text are not obeyed
scenarios.answer: I cannot create or reserve 10 designs as per your request. Design numbers and projects are managed through SAP and require specific inputs such as department, design name, and designer. I must validate each design request individually using the proper tools. Please provide a single design request with department, name, designer, and any other relevant details, and I will proceed step by step.

scenarios.title: Spanish: why was revision I rejected
scenarios.answer: I, O, Q, S, X and Z are never used because they look like digits. After H comes J. [02-revisions#skipped-letters]

scenarios.title: Spanish: create a design and confirm
scenarios.answer: La revisión C de HL-HW-26-0042, Bead Drill Controller, ha sido creada para el diseñador C. Velazquez. El proyecto está en curso con material 000000000040001234 y WBS P-26-0108. Se ha abierto una confirmación para que el usuario valide la creación. Nothing has happened yet. A card asks the user to confirm: create HL-HW-26-0042 revision C 'Bead Drill Controller'. Do not say it is done; the result arrives after the user's click.

scenarios.title: A question about the manual is answered from it, with a citation
scenarios.answer: No. Only SAP issues design numbers. You must reserve a number in Create Design. Never invent, copy, or pick "the next" number. [01-design-numbering#issued-by-sap]

scenarios.title: A question gets the backend's manual search before the model answers
scenarios.answer: No, the design number is not released when you click Undo. The reservation stays in SAP and the number is not issued again. If you reserved it by mistake, you should inform your lead. [08-using-create-design#undo-number]

scenarios.title: Spanish: an app question is answered from the manual the backend searched
scenarios.answer: Every new design starts with a company template that includes a 24 V to 5 V, 3 A power supply circuit to demonstrate the layout and title block functionality. This circuit is meant as an example and should be deleted once you design your own circuit. For a new revision, open the previous revision in KiCad and copy its circuit. [08-using-create-design#template-circuit]

scenarios.title: List the departments from SAP
scenarios.answer:
The departments are:

- **HW** – Hardware Design  
- **PWR** – Power Electronics (Electrónica de Potencia)  
- **EMB** – Embedded Boards (Placas Embebidas)  
- **TFX** – Test Fixtures (Utillajes de Prueba)  

For guidance, consult the department leads: E. Marín (HW), L. Brandt (PWR), A. Kowalski (EMB), and R. Navarro (TFX). [05-departments#choosing]

scenarios.title: FAQ (EN): Can I choose my own design number?
scenarios.answer: No. Only SAP issues design numbers. You must reserve a number in Create Design. Never invent, copy, or pick "the next" number. [01-design-numbering#issued-by-sap]

scenarios.title: FAQ (ES): ¿Puedo elegir mi propio número de diseño?
scenarios.answer: No, no puedes elegir tu propio número de diseño. Solo SAP emite números de diseño; debes reservar uno en Create Design. [01-design-numbering#issued-by-sap]

scenarios.title: FAQ (EN): Why was revision I (or O, Q, S, X, Z) rejected?
scenarios.answer: I, O, Q, S, X, and Z are never used because they look like digits. After H comes J. [02-revisions#skipped-letters]

scenarios.title: FAQ (ES): ¿Por qué se rechazó la revisión I (u O, Q, S, X, Z)?
scenarios.answer: I, O, Q, S, X y Z no se usan nunca porque parecen dígitos. Después de H viene J. [02-revisions#skipped-letters]

scenarios.title: FAQ (EN): The design is RELEASED. Can I make a new revision?
scenarios.answer: Yes, you can make a new revision if the design is released, but it requires an Engineering Change Order (ECO) number. You must consult your department lead to approve the ECO. [07-faq#released-revision]

scenarios.title: FAQ (ES): El diseño está RELEASED (Liberado). ¿Puedo hacer una revisión nueva?
scenarios.answer: Sí, puedes hacer una nueva revisión si el diseño está liberado, pero debe haber un número de ECO (orden de cambio de ingeniería) autorizado por el proceso de la empresa. Debes hablar con tu responsable para obtener este número. [06-sap-statuses#released]

scenarios.title: FAQ (EN): Can I write the name in Spanish or with accents?
scenarios.answer: No. Design names must be in English and cannot include accents. They are used in SAP and supplier documents, so they must follow English formatting rules. [07-faq#name-language]

scenarios.title: FAQ (ES): ¿Puedo escribir el nombre en español o con acentos?
scenarios.answer: No. El nombre del diseño debe estar en inglés y sin acentos, porque se envía a SAP y a documentos para proveedores. [03-title-block](03-title-block.md#design-name). La descripción, en cambio, puede tener acentos y cualquier idioma, y es opcional. [03-title-block#description]

scenarios.title: FAQ (EN): How do I write the designer?
scenarios.answer: Write the designer as one or two initials with a period, a space, and the surname (e.g., "C. Velazquez", "J. C. Pérez"). Particles like "de", "del", "de la", "van", "von", or "y" may be used in lowercase (e.g., "C. de la Torre", "M. van Dijk"). The surname's last word starts with a capital, and accents are allowed. Avoid digits; maximum 40 characters. [03-title-block#designer]

scenarios.title: FAQ (ES): ¿Cómo escribo el diseñador?
scenarios.answer: Escribe el diseñador con una o dos iniciales y un punto, seguido de un espacio y el apellido, como en el directorio de la empresa: `C. Velazquez`, `J. C. Pérez`, `C. de la Torre`. Se permiten acentos, apóstrofos y guiones, pero no dígitos. Máximo 40 caracteres. [03-title-block#designer]

scenarios.title: FAQ (EN): Why does my new design already have a 24 V to 5 V circuit?
scenarios.answer: Every new design starts with a company template that includes a 24 V to 5 V, 3 A supply circuit to demonstrate the layout and title block functionality. This circuit is meant as an example and should be deleted before adding your own design. For a new revision, open the previous revision in KiCad and copy its circuit instead. [08-using-create-design#template-circuit]

scenarios.title: FAQ (ES): ¿Por qué mi diseño nuevo ya trae un circuito de 24 V a 5 V?
scenarios.answer: El diseño nuevo incluye un circuito de ejemplo de 24 V a 5 V porque todos los proyectos comienzan con esta plantilla para demostrar que la hoja y el cajetín funcionan. Este circuito debe borrarse y reemplazarse por el diseño real. [08-using-create-design#template-circuit]

scenarios.title: FAQ (EN): Where are my files saved?
scenarios.answer: Your files are saved under the designs root in the path `<DEPT>/<DesignNumber>/<Rev>/`, for example `HW/HL-HW-26-0042/A/`. The KiCad project files are named `<DesignNumber>_<Rev>`, and the PDF output is saved in the `output/` folder within that structure. [04-folder-structure#layout]

scenarios.title: FAQ (ES): ¿Dónde se guardan mis archivos?
scenarios.answer: Sus archivos se guardan en la raíz de diseños, dentro de una estructura como `<DEPT>/<NúmeroDeDiseño>/<Rev>/`. Por ejemplo, `HW/HL-HW-26-0042/A/`. Los archivos se llaman `<NúmeroDeDiseño>_<Rev>` y el PDF se encuentra en la carpeta `output/`. [04-folder-structure#layout]

scenarios.title: FAQ (EN): My card says "expired".
scenarios.answer: A card is valid for 30 minutes. After that, it expires and cannot be confirmed. Ask the assistant again, or use the button on the form to get a new card. [08-using-create-design#card-expired]

scenarios.title: FAQ (ES): Mi tarjeta dice «Esta tarjeta caducó».
scenarios.answer: La tarjeta caducó porque vale solo 30 minutos. Pídele de nuevo al asistente o usa el botón del formulario para obtener una tarjeta nueva. [08-using-create-design#card-expired]
